headline: 45 of 45 rehearsal runs passed
detail: 25 of 25 single-fault runs named the right cause; the rest are the honesty scenarios of beat 7.
method: Each scenario is injected once into the live lab; 90 s after the first alert, five agents investigate it in parallel, each from scratch, so this measures how consistent the answer is on one incident, not a sample of different incidents. A run passes when its primary cause is in the accepted set (graded by code, not by a model); an Opus reviewer then read every run's evidence against its tool results. Cost is the API-equivalent price Claude Code reports per run. Payment, pg-network-delay and decoy were re-run on the final code; the other six rows were measured just before that last fix (a 20 ms latency floor, flag-service streams left out of client errors, two prompt rules).
